caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a dark brown finish and decorative yellowish-green accents. The chair has a simple, rectangular back with three horizontal slats; the top slat is curved and features gold-colored decorative ring details at the connections. The central slat displays a painted image of a basket containing green fruit or vegetables with surrounding floral motifs, all rendered in green and yellow hues. The seat is cane-woven and light beige in color, with a rectangular wooden frame. The legs and supports of the chair are rounded and turned, adorned with gold-green bands at several points. The chair includes side and front stretchers, also detailed with gold accents. The drawing is rendered on a plain, light beige background, and the signature "Lawrence Flynn" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Hitchcock chair
